WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_CM216_20231213 
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'
    AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' --AND @Businessdate BETWEEN CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODSTARTDATE,112) AND ISNULL(CONVERT(VARCHAR,PERIODENDDATE,112),'20991231')
)
,
Cnt_DCA
AS(

select Accountid,
count(shareindicator) as CNT
 from dw.dimcustomeraccount_CM216_20231213 where shareindicator = 'y'
 group by accountid
)
,
Balance AS (
SELECT 
CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCPB.PeriodStartDate,112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
,BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode
,BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId
,BCPB.BalanceAmount
,ISNULL(NULLIF(DCA.CNT,''),1) CNT
FROM 
CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCPB
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_CM216_20231213 CAFP ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication_CM216_20231213 FPA ON CAFP.ProductId = FPA.FinancialProductId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount_CM216_20231213 BCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch_CM216_20231213 DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank_CM216_20231213 DDBK ON BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount_CM216_20231213 DDA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID
LEFT JOIN Cnt_DCA DCA ON BCPB.CustomerAccountId = DCA.AccountId 
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
--and @Businessdate NOT IN (SELECT BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance)
)
select * into dw.factdepoutstdbal_Balance from Balance;

with GetMinMaxDate AS (
SELECT 
    BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,SourceSystemCode
    ,convert(DATE, MIN(BusinessDateSK)) AS min_date
    ,CONVERT(DATE, MAX(BusinessDateSK)) AS max_date 
  FROM 
     dw.factdepoutstdbal_Balance
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL) --AND BusinessDateSK >= '2023-01-01'
	GROUP BY BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountID ,SourceSystemCode
)
,FullDateBalance AS (
SELECT 
	BranchSK
    ,BankSK
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
	,SourceSystemCode
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,fulldate,112) AS fulldate2
    ,a.FullDate
    ,b.min_date 
    ,b.max_date 
  FROM 
    dw.dimdate a 
    LEFT JOIN GetMinMaxDate b
	ON a.FullDate >= b.min_date 
    AND a.FullDate <= b.max_date 
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
,distinct_balance AS (
SELECT DISTINCT 
    BranchSK ,BankSK ,AccountSK ,AccountId ,BusinessDateSK ,BalanceAmount ,SourceSystemCode ,WorkFlowId ,TaskRunId ,InsertDttm ,IsoCurrencyCode ,FinancialInstitutionId ,CNT
FROM  dw.factdepoutstdbal_Balance b
WHERE (BranchSK IS NOT NULL
    AND BankSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountSK IS NOT NULL
    AND AccountID IS NOT NULL
    AND SourceSystemCode IS NOT NULL)
)
, join_balance as (
select 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,ISNULL(b.BusinessDateSK, a.FullDate),112)  AS BusinessDateSK
,ISNULL(b.BranchSK,a.BranchSK) AS BranchSK
,ISNULL(b.BankSK,a.BankSK) AS BankSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountSK,a.AccountSK) AS AccountSK
,ISNULL(b.AccountId,a.AccountId) AS AccountId
,ISNULL(b.SourceSystemCode,a.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,ISNULL(b.WorkFlowId,0) AS WorkFlowId
,ISNULL(b.TaskRunId,0) AS TaskRunId
,ISNULL(b.InsertDttm,getdate()) AS InsertDttm                           
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,BalanceAmount
,CNT
,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.BankSK,a.AccountId ORDER BY a.FullDate ) AS Row#
, case when [BalanceAmount] is null then 0 else 1 end as ChangeIndicator
FROM FullDateBalance a
LEFT JOIN DISTINCT_BALANCE b
    ON a.BranchSK = b.BranchSK
    AND a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    AND a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    AND a.AccountID = b.AccountID
    AND a.fulldate2 = b.BusinessDateSK
    AND a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode

)
select * into dw.factdepoutstdbal_join_balance from join_balance;
select *, Sum(ChangeIndicator) over (PARTITION BY BankSK, AccountId ORDER BY Row#) RowGroup into dw.factdepoutstdbal_rowgrp from dw.factdepoutstdbal_join_balance

with final_balance as (
select 
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,case when BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode is not null then BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode else first_value(BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end IsoCurrencyCode
,case when BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId is not null then BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId else first_value(BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end FinancialInstitutionId
,case when [BalanceAmount] is not null then BalanceAmount else first_value(BalanceAmount) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end BalanceAmount
,case when [CNT] is not null then CNT else first_value(CNT) over (partition by RowGroup,AccountId,BankSK ORDER BY Row#) end CNT
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm                           
from dw.factdepoutstdbal_rowgrp BCPB) 

select * into dw.factdepoutstdbal_final_balance from final_balance;

with CurrencyConversion
AS(
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates_CM216_20231213 WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV'
)

--INSERT INTO DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_CM216_20231213
--(
--     BusinessDateSK
--    ,BranchSK
--    ,BankSK
--    ,AccountSK
--    ,AccountID
--    ,BalanceAmountFull_Original
--    ,BalanceAmountProrated_Original
--    ,Currency_Original
--    ,Currency_Target
--    ,PesoConversionRate
--    ,BalanceAmountFull
--    ,BalanceAmountProrated
--    ,SourceSystemCode
--    ,WorkFlowId
--    ,TaskRunId
--    ,InsertDttm
--)

select 
CONVERT(VARCHAR,convert(date,BusinessDateSK),112) as BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK as BranchSK
,BankSK as BankSK
,AccountSK as AccountSK
,AccountId as AccountId
,BCPB.BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmountFull_Original
,ISNULL(BCPB.BalanceAmount / CNT,BCPB.BalanceAmount) AS BalanceAmountProrated_Original
,ISNULL(BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode,'PHP') AS Currency_Original
,'PHP' AS Currency_Target
,ISNULL(CC.ConversionRate,1) AS PesoConversionRate
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate
    ELSE BalanceAmount END BalanceAmountFull
,CASE WHEN IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN (BalanceAmount * CC.ConversionRate )/ ISNULL(NULLIF(CNT,''),1)
    ELSE BalanceAmount / ISNULL(NULLIF(CNT,''),1)  
    END BalanceAmountProrated
,BCPB.SourceSystemCode as SourceSystemCode
,BCPB.WorkFlowId as WorkFlowId
,BCPB.TaskRunId as TaskRunId
,BCPB.InsertDttm as InsertDttm
INTO DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_CM216_20231213   
from  dw.factdepoutstdbal_final_balance   BCPB
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON  BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode  = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCPB.BusinessDateSK) = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
